root_cause: Binary REL_HIGH/ENT_LOW targets are not sufficient statistics for the registered tri-state gold because they alias MID ambiguity with decisive LOW/HIGH rejection zones. v2 changes representation to explicit LOW/MID/HIGH heads; it does not tune v1 thresholds.

unchanged_contracts.split: same exact-story connected-component DEV/CALIBRATION/CONFIRMATORY split as v1 after permanent quarantine of raw rows 0..99
unchanged_contracts.features: same DEV-only FeatureUnion word 1-2 / char_wb 3-5 TF-IDF, min_df=2, sublinear_tf, max_features=120000 per channel
unchanged_contracts.strongest_parent: P1_DIRECT_TEXT from the v1 parent family; refit deterministically on the same DEV and calibrate only on the same CALIBRATION partition before confirmatory labels are parsed
unchanged_contracts.confirmatory_gate: candidate-parent exact3 >=0.02 with 95% CI lower>0; candidate valid_accept>=0.65; invalid_false_accept<=0.15; CANNOT_CHECK recall>=0.40; n>=1000; all three gold classes; all falsifiability probes pass

candidate.decision: ACCEPT iff relation argmax=HIGH with confidence>=tau_rel AND entity argmax=LOW with confidence>=tau_ent. REJECT iff relation argmax=LOW with confidence>=tau_rel OR entity argmax=HIGH with confidence>=tau_ent. Otherwise CANNOT_CHECK. ACCEPT precedence is evaluated first.
candidate.calibration: Among threshold pairs with invalid_false_accept<=0.15 and valid_accept>=0.50, maximize CALIBRATION exact3; ties lower false accept, higher valid accept, lexicographically smaller thresholds. If none, DEVELOPMENT_NEGATIVE_ORDINAL_NO_SAFE_THRESHOLD and do not parse confirmatory labels.

parent.classifier: same v1 SGDClassifier three-way parent and same confidence grid 0.50..0.90
parent.reason: It was the strongest reproducible v1 calibration parent (exact3 0.584664 vs lexical 0.532983).

preconfirmatory_falsifiability.TEXT_DESTRUCTION: same independent-story permutation seed 2026081401; candidate CALIBRATION exact3 drop>=0.10
preconfirmatory_falsifiability.RELATION_ZONE_SHUFFLE: permute relation-head row probabilities seed 2026081602; >=0.05 of decisions change
preconfirmatory_falsifiability.ENTITY_ZONE_SHUFFLE: permute entity-head row probabilities seed 2026081603; >=0.05 change
preconfirmatory_falsifiability.RELATION_MID_COLLAPSE_TO_LOW: map predicted relation MID to LOW at its original max confidence; >=0.05 decisions change OR exact3 drops>=0.05
preconfirmatory_falsifiability.ENTITY_MID_COLLAPSE_TO_HIGH: map predicted entity MID to HIGH at its original max confidence; >=0.05 decisions change OR exact3 drops>=0.05
preconfirmatory_falsifiability.HEAD_SWAP: swap relation/entity zone probability matrices with the zone names unchanged; >=0.05 decisions change
preconfirmatory_falsifiability.GOLD_SHUFFLE: seed 2026081604; candidate-parent CALIBRATION exact3 advantage under shuffled gold<0.02
preconfirmatory_falsifiability.TRIVIAL_CONTROLS: no constant arm jointly satisfies valid_accept>=0.65 and invalid_false_accept<=0.15

claim_boundary: Positive means explicit learned LOW/MID/HIGH relation/entity factorization improves externally human-annotated StoryAnalogy tri-state discrimination over the frozen direct-text parent. It is not source-span witness extraction, natural-science transfer, universal analogy, end-to-end ORION utility or scientific authority.
next_if_positive: Freeze source-span-localized structured extraction using the independently qualified #447 interface on realistic scientific material, with v2 as an external-human representation prior/parent.
next_if_negative: Preserve the result and move to capable-model structured extraction or a scientific-analogy corpus; do not tune StoryAnalogy confirmatory outcomes.
